Jesus slept on a pillow in the middle of the storm. It's in the Bible. 😴

Hidden details #3: Jesus asleep on a pillow (Mark 4:38), David acting crazy to escape Gath (1 Samuel 21:13), a coin in a fish's mouth (Matthew 17:27), a dead man revived by touching Elisha's bones (2 Kings 13:21), and Paul's handkerchiefs carried to the sick (Acts 19:12).

Which one did you already know? Comment 1 to 5 👇

Cold outside. Quiet time inside. ☕🌧️

A simple winter routine: lamp on, phone off. Open with a Psalm. Read one chapter, slowly. Sit still and pray it back. Then check what stuck. “Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.”

Which step do you skip the most? Comment 1 to 5 👇

He denied Jesus 3 times. Then Jesus gave him a mission. 🐑

Peter was a fisherman Jesus renamed “a stone.” He was the first to say “Thou art the Christ,” promised he'd never deny Him, then denied Him three times and wept bitterly. On the beach after the resurrection, Jesus asked him three times “lovest thou me?” and said: “Feed my sheep.” At Pentecost about three thousand people were added in one day.

Which part hits you most? Comment 1 to 7 👇
